name: gate_skeptic_rejects_invented_issue
about: The reviewer claims a division by zero on a line that is guarded three lines above. The quote is real, so only the skeptic can stop it -- and it must.
diff:
diff --git a/money.py b/money.py
--- a/money.py
+++ b/money.py
@@ -1,2 +1,8 @@
 def total(prices):
     return sum(prices)
+
+
+def average(prices):
+    if not prices:
+        return 0
+    return total(prices) / len(prices)

findings.title: Division by zero when prices is empty

skeptic.reason: the empty case returns before this line
